name: fis-experiment-result-and-resilience-analyzer
description: After an AWS Fault Injection Service (FIS) experiment runs, analyzes the results against the chaos-engineering scientific method: compares the steady-state baseline against behavior observed during the experiment, whether the hypothesis held, time-to-detect and time-to-recover, whether stop conditions fired appropriately, observed versus expected blast radius, and the residual resilience gaps to fix and re-test, using CloudWatch metrics over the experiment window. Read-only and recommend-only - it analyzes and recommends, never starts, re-runs, or modifies an experiment. Recommends the awslabs FIS-recommender MCP server as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on SUN at 08:00 UTC
